name: Hajj-AI Synthetic Challenge Set v1
design_notes: Original M5/V7 datasets and model code unchanged
Reliability and source facts are synthetic, not measured sensor calibration
V7 uses quality flags and ignores source_reliability in aggregation; no actual verification exchange
Latent gold is hidden clean simulation label; oracle_expected_status is the policy action for currently visible evidence
Evaluation on the cases does not establish real-world operational safety or intrinsic Multi superiority
